bioParagraphs: I am a Junior Full Stack Developer with professional experience building web features and client interfaces. Currently working at Softleed Company, I implement, maintain, and update responsive features across frontend frameworks, backend code, and relational databases.
My core development focus is on writing clean, modular code, building solid REST APIs, and collaborating with team members on client needs.
